title: A masterpiece
text: Experiencing such an architectural masterpiece was breathtaking. The two hours we spent there, were not enough. Photos will not do it justice.
author: jsF700SN

title: Sagrada Família and Park Guell
text: We were eight people looking for a guided tour to Sagrada Família, but we couldn’t find any available. That’s when we stumbled upon Sun2Spain. They didn’t have enough spots, but they were so helpful and managed to get us all in! It was amazing! We also asked them about Park Güell, and they offered us a combo tours, which was super nice it was hassle free and included transportation. Overall, it was a great experience. We really loved our guide and the tour organizer they were so helpful with reminders and all the details. They are a very transparent tour operator, and I highly recommend them.
author: triciamI6566IG

title: The Sagrada with my Familia
text: Nadia was our guide and she was great! Kind, knowledgeable, and engaging. I highly recommend this tour!
author: tysonl950

title: Book Sun2Spain!
text: We had a private tour with Lena, and it was worth every penny! She was not only knowledgeable but friendly and excited to share everything she knew with us. She was by far the best tour guide and Sun2Spain the best operator we encountered our entire trip. Thank you, Lena and Team!!

title: Super clutch!
